doc_info.description: Metadata, page sizes and labels, bookmarks, annotations, form fields, links, layers, attachments, fonts, security and repair notes.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

doc_info.name: doc_info

page_move.description: Move pages so the first of them lands at position `to` (1-based, counted before the move). Undoable.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

page_move.name: page_move

page_extract.description: Copy pages into a new PDF (links, bookmarks, fields and layers that belong to them come along). separate: true writes each page as its own file into out_dir; delete: true removes the pages from this document afterwards (undoable).

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

open.description: Also open the result as a new document (default: only when out is omitted).

out.description: File to write. Omit to open the result as a new unsaved document instead.

page_extract.name: page_extract

doc_save.description: Save to its own file (an incremental update, which keeps signatures valid) or to a new path (a full rewrite). The write is atomic. flatten_fill_sign bakes Fill & Sign text, marks and signatures into the page first and removes those annotations; other comments and form fields stay. Omit it, or pass false, to leave them editable.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

flatten_fill_sign.description: Bake Fill & Sign marks into the page before writing. Default false.

full.description: Force a full rewrite (or, with false, an incremental update).

path.description: Save as this file. Omit to save in place.

doc_save.name: doc_save
